# Towards Victory — Governor's House training action for Grand General (大将军)
# Appoint/Remove/Change actions are auto-generated in tv_io_leader_actions.txt
# via data/io_leaders.yaml entry id: conquest_general.

tv_train_grand_general = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= {
				is_alive = yes
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
					NOT = { has_variable = tv_gg_training_active }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_training_start_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -100
	}
}

# ── Governor management actions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Governor appointment/removal is only available while an alive Grand General is in office.
# Existing governors remain in tv_governor_list if the Grand General leaves office.

# Appoints a governor: 2-step selection (character → area).
# step 1 sets scope:target (character), step 2 sets scope:target_1 (area).
tv_appoint_governor = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_appoint_governor_select_char"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_appoint_governor_no_chars"
		column = { data = character_info }
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_adult = yes
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
			is_loyal = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_is_governor }
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = area
		source = actor
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_appoint_governor_select_area"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_appoint_governor_no_areas"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_area = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_governor_appoint_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 0
	}
}

# Dismisses the governor whose character is pre-set as scope:recipient by the GUI button.
tv_remove_governor = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_GOVHOUSE_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_govhouse_member }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_CONQUEST_GENERAL_CHAR_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
		}
		scope:actor = {
			var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_governor_remove_effect = yes
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 0
	}
}
